scope_note: A party compilation on the Bharatiya Janata Party's own e-Library (DSpace, library.bjp.org, item 123456789/248), served as a static bitstream without Content-Encoding (Last-Modified Tue, 08 Nov 2016 07:34:08 GMT; no ETag). The PDF was made in November 2016 (PDF CreationDate 8 November 2016); it reprints dated party texts, each under a printed heading giving the body, place and date. Presidential addresses of 1980-1993 under three named section headings: 'DR. MM JOSHI' (the cover, PDF p.1; addresses at pp.3-72), 'SHRI LK ADVANI' (p.73; pp.75-202) and 'SHRI ATAL BIHARI VAJPAYEE' (p.203; pp.205-324); pp.74 and 204 are blank backs. The addresses print no speaker's name, and the section headings contradict each other for the same farewell (p.28 under 'DR. MM JOSHI', p.85 under 'SHRI LK ADVANI'), so this packet never takes a speaker's name from a section heading.

rows.role_title: National President of the Bharatiya Janata Party
rows.text: In an address printed under 'National Council / New Delhi 31 January, 1991', in the section the compilation heads 'SHRI LK ADVANI' (p.73), the speaker, whom the text does not name, says 'Today, it is the last sitting of the National Executive' and 'Tomorrow, our renowned associate Dr. Murli Manohar Joshi would be taking over as President of Bharatiya Janata Party'.

locator.item: National Council, New Delhi 31 January, 1991, first paragraph

rows.role_title: National President of the Bharatiya Janata Party
rows.text: The same farewell is printed, in different words, under 'National Executive / Jaipur 1-3 February, 1991' in the section the compilation heads 'DR. MM JOSHI': 'Today is the last meeting of this National Executive. Tomorrow, a distinguished colleague of ours, Dr. MM Joshi will be assuming the stewardship of the BJP as Party President'.

locator.item: National Executive, Jaipur 1-3 February, 1991: 'BJP is no Longer a Peripheral Party', first paragraph

rows.role_title: National President of the Bharatiya Janata Party
rows.text: In both printings of the farewell the speaker, whom the text does not name, thanks colleagues and office-bearers for their support 'during my tenure as Party President' (p.28; 'during my tenure as President of the party', p.85) and looks back on a five-year tenure.

locator.item: second and third paragraphs of each printing

rows.role_title: National President of the Bharatiya Janata Party
rows.text: In the address printed under 'National Council / Jaipur 1 February, 1991' the speaker, whom the text does not name, thanks the party's workers 'who have honoured an ordinary fellow-worker like me by entrusting to him the onerous responsibility of presidentship of the Party', and later prays to prove worthy of the confidence 'with which you have entrusted to me the responsibility of presidentship of the party'.

locator.item: National Council, Jaipur 1 February, 1991: opening paragraph (p.31) and 'Advani Ji takes the Party to New Heights' (p.32)

rows.role_title: National President of the Bharatiya Janata Party
rows.text: The same address says Shri Lal Krishna Advani was a worthy successor of Shri Vajpayee, that everyone wished 'he should continue as our President for a third term', and that 'like Shri Vajpayee, Shri Advani declined it'.

locator.item: 'Advani Ji takes the Party to New Heights', first paragraph
